name: Bahsi Geçen Kanal
source: "The Channel in Question," a visual novel project created to celebrate Lordakca's channel reaching 10,000 subscribers, was developed with the help of over 20 volunteers. This project features 40 different endings, 6 different routes, and one true ending. You can play this visual novel for free, completing the entire content in approximately 2 hours. You can even play and finish the game directly from the pop-up window on this page. Have fun!
translation: “The Channel in Question”是一个视觉小说项目，旨在庆祝Lordakca的频道拥有10,000名订阅者，该项目是在20多名志愿者的帮助下开发的。该项目有40个不同的结局、6条不同的路线和一个真实的结局。你可以免费畅玩这部视觉小说，大约需要2小时即可完成全部内容。你甚至可以直接从该页面的弹出窗口玩并完成游戏。玩得开心！
